description: This file defines the Zend_Validate_InArray class, a validation class in the Zend Framework that checks if a value exists within a specified array (haystack), with optional strict type checking.

classes.name: Zend_Validate_InArray
classes.description: A validation class that checks if a given value is in a predefined array, with optional strict type comparison.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the validator with a haystack array and optional strict mode.

methods.name: setHaystack
methods.description: Sets the haystack array to be used for validation.

methods.name: getStrict
methods.description: Returns whether strict type checking is enabled.

methods.name: setStrict
methods.description: Enables or disables strict type checking.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if the provided value exists in the haystack, considering strict mode if enabled.
